Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiments (FLAG-IP and BioID2) specifically used HEK293T cells to identify substrates of OTUD6B via overexpression of the protein. Other perturbations mentioned in the text (shRNA, CRISPR screen, patient cohorts) were not part of the mass spectrometry analysis described in the methods.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment used a Q Exactive HF (DDA) with label-free quantification (LFQ) algorithms enabled in MaxQuant for both FLAG-IP and BioID2 datasets.

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: Proximity-based labeling using BioID2 was explicitly used to identify OTUD6B interactors.
Affinity-based purification using FLAG-tagged OTUD6B was used.

workflow: The match-between-runs and label-free quantification algorithms were enabled.
Mass spectrometric analyses to identify substrates of OTUD6B were performed both affinity-based (FLAG-purification) and proximity-based (BioID2).
analyzed by nanoLC-MS/MS on an Eksigent NanoLC-Ultra 1D+ system coupled to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer
Peptide and protein identification and quantification for BioIDs were performed using MaxQuant 1.5.3.30
search_parameters: Samples were reduced by DTT and alkylated by chloroacetamide.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The study employs two distinct capture methods (FLAG-IP and BioID2) to identify substrates/interactors of OTUD6B, both processed via DDA-LFQ. While the biological focus is on ubiquitylation (K48 chains), the MS analysis described is for protein identification and abundance, not site-specific ubiquitylation mapping (which was done via immunoblotting).

acquisition: sequential isolation of up to 20 precursors
MS2 spectra for peptide identification were recorded in the Orbitrap
quantification: MS1 intensity based label-free quantification method
specialized: biotinylated proteins purified with strep-tactin superflow resin

MStype_prompt.notes: The experiment uses two distinct proteomics approaches: a standard AP-MS (FLAG-IP) and a proximity labeling approach (BioID2). Both were analyzed using DDA and LFQ. While the study focuses on deubiquitylation (ubiquitin system), the mass spectrometry was used for substrate identification (interactomics) rather than a diGly-remnant enrichment workflow.

Treatment_prompt.reasoning: transfected with FLAG-EV or FLAG-OTUD6B; transfected with myc-BioID2-EV, myc-BioID2-OTUD6B-IF1 or -IF2
